visual_connections.description: Arrow drawn from Developers to GitHub representing pushing code.
Arrow drawn from GitHub to Lambda representing code push webhook/event trigger.
Arrow drawn from Lambda to SQS representing queuing an analysis request.
Arrow drawn pointing from ECS Fargate to SQS representing pulling messages from the queue.
Arrow drawn from ECS Fargate to GitHub representing cloning the repository code.
Arrow drawn from ECS Fargate to EC2 representing pushing analysis reports to the EC2 API.
Curved arrow drawn from Developers to EC2 representing calling the UI or API.
Curved arrow drawn from EC2 to Aurora representing storing analysis reports.
Top arrow between ECS Fargate (Compute Engine) and Aurora representing pulling reports from the database.
Bottom arrow pointing to Aurora representing updating the database with computed quality metrics.
Red arrow pointing up from ECS Fargate (Compute Engine) to ES representing storing search and optimization data.
